description: Avanceon Limited is a Pakistani industrial automation and systems-integration company listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It designs and implements industrial control and automation systems, manufacturing execution systems, industrial data and analytics platforms, and provides managed support and cybersecurity for plant systems. Its customers are concentrated in food and beverage, consumer packaged goods, water and wastewater, life sciences, specialty chemicals and metals. The business now trades as Actemium Avanceon, having merged with VINCI Energies' Actemium network.
